name: 67449 · Herington, KS
findings: ZIP 67449 (Herington) has 15 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 8 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 67449 (Herington) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
